text: Refrigerator door.  Easy to install.

I received the product and thought it may have been a different handle, but once I connected it, securing it to the doors (fridge and freezer) was fast and easy.  The screws were perfect for the freezer, but took a little work on the fridge side to get both screws all the way in.  The single anchor screw had to be loosened a little, but that was not a problem.  After getting it on, it looks perfect.

I ordered this as a replacement in 2019, for the stock fridge handle that cracked and broke. The build quality and fit and finish appeared to be a good match for the original, but was a couple mm more shallow, so didn't line up with the original freezer handle. Swapping that out as well was fine, despite there having been no issue with the original freezer handle.

Now, in 2022, the replacement handle has cracker again, and is on it's last legs. The replacement doesn't seem as sturdy as the original, only lasting ~3 years. That said, I am happy to purchase the same, as these are pretty minor gripes, hence the 4 stars.

The washer timer did not work, we have been having to use an old kitchen timer so that we can figure out when to stop the washer. Spinner timer works fine. Clothes put into the spinner must be compressed and level or it will not be balanced. Was very scary the first few times we used it until we had enough trialand error to know how to balance the load properly. The clothes are usually very stiff after drying. I recommend doing a couple of rinse/spin cycles before hanging them up to dry.

Just like a lot of the reviews I've read, I live in an apartment, with a communal washer that's disgusting, and expensive to use! I told my wife I had purchased this machine and boy, was she skeptical!

The delivery came a lot quicker, than the suggested window of time!

I placed the unit inside my tub, hooked the water line to my shower, and began washing clothes. I could not believe the amount of dirt that was coming out of the washes! It took me a couple of times to get a handle on how to figure just how big, or small the loads had to be, in order to achieve a good cleaning & flow. Practice makes perfect! By the time my wife came home, I had washed most of our clothes. While washing, I noticed, I am not using half the detergent I had been using in the commercial washer. By washing smaller loads, the clothes are naturally cleaner and smell fresher! The spinner! Man, it is really powerful! Just as stated, by many other reviewers, My clothes were practically dry, when done!

I got one of those 4 item dryer replacement kits from Amazon, but the cycling thermostat said 240 volts, which I assume is for the heater element (2 smaller pins) since all electric dryers use 240 volts.  I bought this one because it said 120 volts, and the thermostat heater in my dryer runs off a 120 volt circuit, and is supposed to have a resistance of ~ 3500 ohms.  This one had a resistance of 7800 ohms, the same as the 240 volt version.  After changing out the faulty 250F high limit therm from the original order and replacing the 309F fuse in that kit with a 352F fuse (per spec), the dryer works and cycles OK now, but I am keeping it on the delicate setting for now since I don't want it to get too hot and blow out the high limit (352F) fuse again.  Even the delicate setting gets plenty hot, but I wish all these dryer parts had better specs listed so you wouldn't have to order over and over again to find the right combination.  But they are all made in China so it's hard to tell what you're going to get.
